role: fixed_driver_contract_for_independent_producers; not a completed implementation or fake service

runtime.page: actual product WebView2 Page, one isolated process/profile owned by caller
runtime.invoke: production Tauri project_api; response/auth/Scope/revision not mocked
runtime.files: optional injected production_selected_path adapter; absence is explicit not_evaluable, never fabricate SelectedFileRef
runtime.clock: actual renderer/caller monotonic and presented frame collector as required by original NFR

producer_exports.name: runBatch
output: case_results with original task/gap and independent expected
source patch refs if actual defects

sample_policy.unit_synthetic: allowed only marked unit, not Native/formal evidence
sample_policy.actual_case: requires actual process/candidate/input identity and real readback

independence: Each producer must finish its own complete scripts/assertions/finite relevant selfchecks from fixed inputs; does not await another batch or require cross-chat communication. Root later supplies production files/clock adapters and executes missing original cases. Reporting/player batch executes its independent real browser/player cases directly.
ownership: Only batch-owned directory mutable; no main source/build/shared desktop/current C36/500 assets/control JSON/global skills/ports table edits except own unique port registration at actual use; no auto commit/push.
